title: Home
description: DevOps / DevSecOps engineer — AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes and cloud security.

blocks.heading: Shivam Sharma
blocks.body: I run production AWS infrastructure for two enterprise clients — security, compliance and cost across a multi-account organisation, and end-to-end DevOps for a multi-environment EKS platform.

items.label: AWS accounts — consolidated from 70+ with Terraform
monthly cost of my own infrastructure

items.title: Cloud security & compliance
items.body: Security Hub, GuardDuty and a Wazuh SIEM; CIS, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls across a multi-account AWS organisation.

items.title: Infrastructure as code
items.body: Terraform for everything — 70+ AWS accounts consolidated to 47, and one state per provider for my own clouds.

items.title: Kubernetes & CI/CD
items.body: Amazon EKS across three environments; Azure Pipelines and GitHub Actions with SonarQube and Trivy gates.

items.title: Observability & cost
items.body: Prometheus, Grafana and Loki built from scratch; part of a team that cut ~$120K a year from AWS spend.

blocks.heading: The longer story
blocks.body: From an AI/ML degree to running production AWS for two enterprise clients, and building a password manager, a CVE platform and more on free tiers.
